zh.title: 如何比较湾区城市与社区
zh.seo_title: 如何比较湾区城市与社区｜陈靖
zh.description: 比较湾区城市要看什么？本文给出四步比较法和核查清单，涵盖通勤、学区归属、房产税附加项目、HOA、火灾与地震分区、规划变化，并说明去哪里查官方资料，资料截至 2026 年 11 月。
zh.lead: 城市之间的差别要落到具体地址上才有意义。用同一张表比较两三个候选区域。

en.title: How to Compare Bay Area Cities and Neighborhoods
en.seo_title: Compare Bay Area Cities and Neighborhoods | Jing Chen
en.description: A four-step method for comparing Bay Area areas: commute, school district, tax add-ons, HOA, fire and earthquake zones, and where to verify each.
en.lead: City differences only matter once they land on a specific address. Compare two or three areas on one sheet.
